findings.claim: In bootstrap mode the additionalDirectories reconcile duty never happens. Spec-5 correctness-59/60 require the orchestrator to append missing registry paths to permissions.additionalDirectories, and bootstrap mode to run the same reconcile duty. The skill moved that write to 'the invoking wrapper' and only verifies and reports (L31, L61), while saying duties 3-7 are identical in bootstrap (L24). Only routines/smine-nightly/run.sh (L298-305) does the append. cmd/bootstrap/run.sh, the bootstrap-mode invoker, only reads additionalDirectories to build --repos (L84) and never writes them. Failing sequence: a developer install adds a repo through /repos without the additional-dir checkbox (handleReposAdd grants only on checkbox or casual), then runs bootstrap. That repo path stays out of additionalDirectories after the run, and the orchestrator only lists it as 'missing'.
findings.evidence: Re-read smine-orchestrate SKILL.md L24 (bootstrap: duties 3-7 identical), L31 (additionalDirectories is wrapper-owned, never written) and L59-61 (step 5 says the invoking wrapper appends; verify and report only). Ran git grep additionalDirectories over routines/ and cmd/bootstrap/ at the head: the only write is routines/smine-nightly/run.sh:298-305, and cmd/bootstrap/run.sh:84 is a jq read. internal/server/repos.go:596 grants only on the opt-in path. Spec item correctness-60 requires the reconcile duty in bootstrap, and nothing performs it there.
findings.fix: In bootstrap mode, have cmd/bootstrap/run.sh run the same append-only jq reconcile as smine-nightly run.sh L298-305 before the orchestrate stage, and make SKILL.md step 5 name both wrappers; or state that bootstrap only reports missing paths and amend the spec.

findings.claim: Duty 4 re-syncs a context pack only when the registry target has docs/context.json. sync_context.sh writes the pack's recorded deploy options to <target>/<contextDir>/context.json (L325, L336), and contextDir can be any name chosen via --context-dir or the interactive prompt (L34, L105-109). Failing sequence: a repo deployed with `sync_context.sh --context-dir ctx <repo>` gets ctx/context.json and no docs/context.json. On every accepted nightly run, orchestrate step 4 skips that registry entry and its pack never refreshes. Spec correctness-59 requires a re-run for every registry entry with a deployed pack, using its recorded options.
findings.evidence: Re-read smine-orchestrate SKILL.md L55-57: the only selector is 'whose target carries docs/context.json'. git grep over cmd/sync/sync_context.sh at the head: CTX_FILE="$CTX_ROOT/context.json" with CTX_ROOT="$TARGET/$CONTEXT_DIR" (L211, L325); CONTEXT_DIR comes from --context-dir (L34) or the prompt (L105-107) and defaults to docs only when empty (L109). Auto-discovery of the recorded options looks only at docs/context.json (L76-77), so the orchestrator would also need to pass --context-dir for a non-docs pack.
findings.fix: Detect a deployed pack as any <target>/<dir>/context.json that carries a .deploy section (or record contextDir in repos.json), and re-run sync_context.sh with --context-dir <dir> so it finds that file's recorded options.
